Twitter Instagram TikTok Twitch Season 7: The Hunt Is On Overview Season 7: The Hunt Is On is the eighth Season of Marvel Rivals, taking place from March 20, 2026 to May 15, 2026. Season 7.0 will run from March 20, 2026 to April 17, 2026 and Season 7.5 will run from April 17, 2026 to May 15, 2026. The season will be eight weeks long instead of the standard nine. This season coincides with the Tablet of Life and Time BattlePass. Alchemax Corporation from the year 2099 descends upon Lower Manhattan, spreading its influence like a plague and transforming entire neighborhoods into their 2099 counterparts. [Fisk] orders a city lockdown, arrests all super heroes from different timelines, and hires Black Cat to steal a mysterious stone tablet. He believes this tablet holds the key to New York's survival, but unknowingly, his actions have crossed the line with the current Tiger Division Director, White Fox. To rescue her captured colleague, Luna Snow, White Fox risks everything to infiltrate this barricaded foreign city. SYMBOLS GUIDE Cosmetics obtained through Twitch Drops are indicated by a logo of the platform. Cosmetics obtained through free events are indicated by a small icon. Cosmetics obtained through the BattlePass or Event Passes are indicated by a small logo of the BattlePass/Event Pass, with a golden lock for Premium rewards. Loki is equipped with an all-new skill set, combining deception, illusions, and powerful Infinity Stone abilities to turn enemies against each other! To claim victory, the other heroes can also summon Hulk under certain conditions, recreating iconic scene from the film! Any updates from this patch will be noted with (Patch 202603026) in front. Global Changes The charge rate for Ultimate Abilities has been nerfed across the board for an approximate 20% reduction of charge rates Vanguards & Duelists Strategists Deadpool (All Roles) Vanguards Angela Captain America Deadpool (Vanguard) Reduce Deadpool In Your Area - Vanguard (Upgraded) Damage Reduction from 40% to 30%. Doctor Strange Reduce the shield value of Shield of the Seraphim from 800 to 700. Emma Frost Hulk Magneto Duelists Black Panther Blade Daredevil Deadpool (Duelist) Increase base health from 250 to 275. Elsa Bloodstone Hawkeye Reduce Base Health from 275 to 250. Human Torch Instantly recover all Fire Cluster ammo energy after not using Blaze Cluster for 1s. More tweaks coming in Season 7.5. Iron Man Magik Psylocke Scarlet Witch Winter Soldier Reduce Roterstern Spell Field Damage on hit from 65 to 55. Strategists Gambit Invisible Woman Luna Snow Idol Aura New Effect: Reduce Ice Arts cooldown by 2s whenever a hero with Idol Aura (self or ally) takes part in a KO. White Fox Team-Ups For all of the changes to team-ups, see Team-Ups Adjusted/Removed Duality Dance (Adam Warlock - Luna Snow) Jeff-Nado (Storm - Jeff the Land Shark) For full Balance Updates, see the following Patch(es): Version 20260320 Other New Content Season 7.0 Album System Allows players to permanently save photos taken with Times Square's photo mode and share them with others Esports Hub Global Tournament Overview: Dive into the world of Marvel Rivals esports. Browse tournaments, regions, teams, and player profiles from every corner of the multiverse. Live Match Streaming: Watch the action unfold in real-time directly inside the game and cheer for your favorite heroes and teams. Instant Replay & Highlights: Relive finished matches with in-game replays and video highlights. (Heads up: some replays may have a viewing expiration!) Schedules, Rules & Standings: Check every region's match schedule, tournament format, results, and live leaderboards. Team Up for Glory: Special partner team bundles will drop alongside the Preseason launch. The Marvel Rivals Championship and Marvel Rivals Clash pages can now be found under the Esports tab. Marvel Rivals Championship Easy Entry: Registration opens about one week into the season, with matches held on weekends throughout the mid and late season. Pro Pathway: Starting from this season, top-performing PC factions can earn Champion Points and race for a spot to compete with the pros! The next qualification opportunity lands mid-2026. For all the fine print, check the Marvel Rivals Championship page in-game. Experimental Feature: CPU Rendering Optimization (PC Only) Head to Settings > Other > Performance Optimization (Beta) to activate this experimental power-up. Enable it to enjoy a potential boost in performance and smoother battles. Note: This is an experimental feature. If you encounter any problems, please contact our customer support team.
